dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* Great. Just great... I don’t wanna do anything...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,2)>I’m completely, utterly burned out...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh. Heya, <$cdef(27)>... Sorry you gotta see
me
like this.

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,9)>Fixin’ up that big ol’ building with you was so much fun...
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>I’ve never worked on anything so exciting before!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I tell ya, I poured everything I had into it... Make no
mistake, it’s my masterpiece!

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But now, well... As you can see, I ain’t got nothin’ left
in me.

<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,1)>I’ve tried imaginin’ other buildings, y’know? HUGE ones!
But none of ’em make me feel anything—like they’re not
even worth buildin’.
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>What am I supposed to do now...?

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, that’s not a bad idea! Maybe a little travel will get me
outta this funk, eh?

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Wallowin’ here feelin’ sorry for myself sure ain’t gonna fix
anything. Maybe it’s time I hit the road and did some
building sightseeing!

<$comeff(2,6)><$voicel(2,5)>Say, those <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers here and there all have a
different look to ’em, don’t they?

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know, I’ve always wanted to see ’em for myself! Think
you could bring me to ’em, <$cdef(27)>?

<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, and maybe you can share some fun memories while
we’re walkin’! <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Can’t have a journey without stories to tell
along the way, eh?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I’d love it if you could bring me to the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers
here and there!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>So, this is it, huh? Gotta say...this is WAY better than
I expected!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>The perfect <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center</color> for a town full of nature!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>And ya first met <$cdef(27)>Professor Tangrowth here too, didn’t ya?
So this is where it all happened—where it all began!
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>C’mon, now! How ’bout ya tell me some stories about
this place?

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... You got everyone workin’ together to make it rain,
all so you could rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix?!
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>And then <$cdef(27)>Kyogre even made an appearance?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,9)>Wow! Now that’s what I call an epic tale! I seriously wish I
coulda been there to see it all myself. <$voicel(2,8)>I can just imagine
all the plants ’n’ everything coming back after the rain...

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>That reminds me... I once heard that the roofs on
buildings are for keepin’ out the rain!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe the humans built roofs so they could watch the rain
together ’n’ still stay dry...

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! That’s gotta be the coolest thing I’ve
ever
seen!
Those
lights
shinin’
on
the
building
look
GREAT!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Speaking of lights...this is where you and <$cdef(27)>Peakychu met,
right, bud?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>How’d that go down? What actually happened?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Huh... So <$cdef(27)>Mosslax was nappin’ in the mountains, and you
lit up the whole town to wake ’em up?

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>And then <$cdef(27)>Raikou showed up with a crash of lightning?!
Now THAT’s what I call a shocking entrance!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Still, I feel a li’l bad for <$cdef(27)>Mosslax... Imagine losin’ your
home and <$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>gettin’ trapped in the mountains while you
were nappin’...

<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>See, I got trapped too one time. I was doin’ a bit of cave
mining for materials <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>when the ceiling suddenly collapsed
on me! I thought I was done for!

<$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>If a kind <$cdef(27)>Diglett hadn’t gotten me outta there, I’d probably
still be lost in that cave...

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>I can’t tell ya how relieved I was to get back to my own
pad, bud. Truly there’s no place like home.

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,7)>I sure hope <$cdef(27)>Mosslax was able to find a place they could
call home...

<$comeff(2,1)><$voicel(2,7)>Now this is a fine building if I ever saw one! <$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,10)>This alone
makes our whole trip worth it!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>I bet lunch would taste even better if ya ate it while
admirin’ this marvelous structure...

<$comeff(2,3)><$voicel(2,5)>Speaking of food, this is where you met <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente, right?
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>What kind of shenanigans did you get up to here, bud?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>Wait... You’re tellin’ me <$cdef(27)>Chef Dente was stuck in a barrel?
<$voicel(2,5)>And there was a <$cdef(27)>Rotom who got into a <$cdef(27)>CD player?

<$voicel(2,5)>You all worked together to set the <$cdef(27)>mood and get a proper
party goin’, <$voicel(2,8)>and then <$cdef(27)>Volcanion showed up?

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Hah! Not where I expected this story to go at all!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Next time you throw one of your parties, make sure you
send an invite my way, bud.

<$emotion(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)>Settin’ the <$cdef(27)>mood for a party, eh... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Gotta say, putting up
decorations and stuff was a good move.

<$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Y’know, now that I think about it, maybe I’ve been too
focused on functionality. <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Might be fun to make somethin’
and go hard on the aesthetic!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Well, thanks for tellin’ me a fun story, bud!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, I think we’ve seen all the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Centers out
there... <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>We should head back to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>,
don’tcha think?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Seein’ as we stopped at all those different places, I think
it’s fittin’ if we wrap up our journey at a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
<oneline><$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>We should head back to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)></color>, eh?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Seein’ as we stopped by all those different places, I think
it’s fittin’ if we wrap up our journey at a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Even familiar places look fresh and new once you get back
from a journey, eh, bud?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>That was just what I needed to shift gears and clear
my head!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)><$voicel(2,7)>I think I was too caught up with makin’ things BIG!

<$voicel(2,5)>But seein’ the different sights, hearin’ your stories...
They made me realize somethin’.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>There’s just no place like home!

<$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>So what I’m gonna make next is...a nice, warm, and
welcoming building where everyone can live together!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks for the inspiration, <$cdef(27)>!
I’ll
make
somethin’
amazing!
Promise!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>, ol’ buddy! I’ve finally
got it!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>I’ve designed this sick building!
You got <$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(1)></color> <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(2940)></color>!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Come on, let’s build one here! Not to worry, bud—I’ll help
ya out!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! Oh, this is the best! I can’t wait to get
to work!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>I need you to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> a <$cdef(27)><$bfull(30)>
somewhere around here, bud.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,839)><$voicel(2,9)>Don’t you worry, though—I’ll be right here, helpin’
you out!
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! This...is the building I designed!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks, bud... Hearing you say that makes me glad I spent
time travelin’ and gettin’ my head sorted out!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>But this isn’t the last of what I’ve got—I’m gonna keep
makin’ stuff that’ll shock and awe!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>...Whoops. Almost forgot to give these to ya.
You got <$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(3)></color> <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(2940)></color>!

<$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>I just wanted to say thanks for helpin’ me out with
everything. Those kits’ll let you build what we just
finished making, <$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,10)>so put ’em to good use!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,7)>And gimme a call anytime when you need to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>
somethin’ else!
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* I just don’t feel like doin’ anything...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ve got something weighin’ on my mind, y’know?

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,8)>I’d be real grateful if you could bring me to the
<$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(4)>...
Y’know, whenever you got a spare moment.
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>D’you think you could bring me to the <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(4)></color>?
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Bah... I’d hoped comin’ here would do the trick.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,3)>Hey there, <$cdef(27)>... Sorry ya gotta see
me
mopin’
around
like this.

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>You remember that giant building we worked on, right?
We made it into the biggest, most amazing building ever!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>I tell ya, I poured everything I had into it... Make no

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>But now, well... As you can see, I ain’t got nothin’ left

But none of ’em make me feel anything—like they’re not
even worth buildin’.

<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,7)>Y’know, I’ve always wanted to see ’em for myself! Think
you could bring me to ’em, <$cdef(27)>?
